AI Overview

AI Mode replied:

Generative engine optimization (GEO) is the practice of structuring content so that artificial intelligence tools cite and feature your brand in their generated answers. 
What is GEO?
  • The Goal: Instead of ranking as the top blue link on a traditional results page, you want your text and brand quoted inside an AI response. 
  • The Tools: It targets systems like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity AI, Claude, and Gemini. 
  • The Shift: Traditional search engine optimization (SEO) uses keywords and backlinks to drive direct clicks. GEO focuses on clear, factual information that language models can easily read, summarize, and attribute
    .
     
Core Best Practices
  • Use Conversational Questions: Write headings and subheadings that match real questions users ask out loud.
  • Provide Factual Clarity: Include clear statistics, expert quotes, and direct answers near the top of your content.
  • Build Broad Authority: Ensure your brand appears across trusted external platforms like Reddit, Wikipedia, and LinkedIn because AI models draw from a wide web ecosystem. 
If you'd like, let me know:
  • Is your business B2B or B2C?
  • What industry or niche are you in?
